in_sanskrit.name: Vibhishana
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vibhishana is a name of the god Vishnu, as well as of the demon king Ravana's brother. The name 'Vibhishana' comes from the Sanskrit word 'vibhishana', which means 'excellent' or 'brave'. In the context of Vishnu, the name signifies his divine qualities and power. In the context of Ravana, it is a symbol of his military prowess and leadership.

in_hindi.name: पंदियान
in_hindi.long_meaning: The sons of 'Pandu', the ancient king of Tamil Nadu. The name 'Pandiyan' is derived from the Tamil word 'pandi', which means 'great' or 'excellent'. The name may also be associated with the Pandava brothers from the Hindu epic Mahabharata, who were believed to be the divine incarnations of Vishnu and Bhagavan.
